Hymn 104: Jesus, Savior, Pilot Me
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: John E. Gould
Lyricist/Text Author: Edward Hopper
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 104 titled "Jesus, Savior, Pilot Me" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John E. Gould and the lyrics were written by Edward Hopper.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
